quote.text: there is but one way to freedom - to despise what is not in our power.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that while you can guide and nurture your child, you cannot control every aspect of their growth—embrace the freedom that comes from focusing on what you can influence.
    • By accepting the limits of control, you create an environment where your child learns resilience and independence, freeing both of you to grow truly in character.
  • Leadership:
    • A wise leader understands that power lies in decisions and actions they can directly shape, not in external circumstances or uncontrollable outcomes.
    • When you let go of worrying about factors beyond your influence, you empower yourself and your team to focus on building a vision and fostering a positive culture.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, success comes from concentrating on aspects like innovation, design, and execution, rather than fretting over unpredictable market forces.
    • Channel your energy into refining what you control—such as user feedback and iterative improvements—which builds resilience and paves the way for authentic progress.
